description: This file contains tests for the UI script related to Windows spawn behavior, specifically testing the functions shouldUseShellForCommand and assertSafeWindowsShellArgs to verify shell usage and argument safety across different platforms.

methods.name: shouldUseShellForCommand
methods.description: Determines if a shell should be used for executing a command on Windows based on the command path.

methods.name: assertSafeWindowsShellArgs
methods.description: Checks if the provided arguments are safe to pass through the Windows shell.
